## When to use

Ecosystem spinner; use Kerf LoadingSpinner.

- Compact indeterminate activity indicator.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use LoadingSpinner for indeterminate activity.

**Alternatives:**

- [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use LoadingSpinner for indeterminate activity.
